about: Gzipped bytes of the built web app before internationalization (commit 03bb798, default build: mock mode), measured by build/bundle-size.ts, plus what later features that are not i18n added. test/bundle-size.test.ts holds the English bundle's growth from i18n under its budgets (40 KB first page, 60 KB in all; unchanged). Re-measured once for v1.12.0 (Wave E: connected apps, syndication, imported history, funder loops, the award kit, bilingual forms), main 6c5d633 against the merged branch built the same way: +4,298 initial (the shared catalog's new import and social words, the forms package's translation reading, the new routes in the app shell) and +91,927 total (the new screens, panels, mocks and their English words), added to both numbers. Re-measured again for v1.13.0 (Wave F: live co-editing, the QuickBooks sync, the operators' measures), v1.12.0 0bdb81c against the merged branch built the same way: -210 initial (the first page needs nothing new) and +25,402 total (the measures and accounting screens, the presence library and its pieces in both editors, the In QuickBooks badge, and their English words in the extras catalog), added to both numbers. Re-measure only when a change that is not i18n moves these numbers, and say so in the commit.
